# Inworld AI

> > Inworld AI provides AI-powered character and NPC platforms for game developers, featuring real-time conversational agents, text-to-speech, and integrations with Unity and Unreal Engine.

Inworld AI offers tools like Inworld Studio, Agent Runtime, and SDKs for Unity and Unreal Engine to create intelligent, interactive AI characters for games, virtual worlds, and immersive experiences. The platform enables developers to build AI NPCs with advanced conversational capabilities, emotions, and dynamic behaviors.

## Key Topics

- Inworld Studio
- AI NPCs
- Unreal Engine integration
- Unity integration
- Text-to-Speech (TTS)
- Speech-to-Text (STT)
- Agent Runtime
- LLM Router
- Realtime API
- MetaHumans
- Generative AI for gaming
- AI character design
- User-generated content (UGC)
- Conversational AI agents
- Interactive AI
